scope: Immediate verified-password notifications; local UI only. No router command, credential verification policy, history persistence semantics or radio mapping changed. OpenWrt command compatibility review exempt for this UI-only change.

delivery.event: PasswordFoundNotice emitted only after verified success and writing the existing result file
delivery.transport: Existing worker progress signal -> reporter typed forwarding -> service passwordFound signal -> GUI QObject slot
delivery.secret: No password in generic message logs, task snapshots or target result records; event repr excludes password and notification consumer clears the payload
delivery.threading: Worker sends data only; widgets constructed by main-thread QObject slot

ui.common_component: ModelessMessageGroup uses shared MessageDialog theme, Qt.NonModal, show and delete-on-close; no exec/open, acknowledgment queue, timers or polling
ui.window_owner: Main window, independent of capture-page lifetime; reconnecting page reuses controller
ui.concurrency: Older notification can remain open while newer notifications arrive; main window remains interactive; all dialogs close independently
ui.overflow: Subsequent results merge into the last window; notice explains bounded display and saved result files
ui.cleanup: Finished/destroyed clears tracked strings; text undo cache disabled; owner destruction releases unacknowledged windows
ui.summary: Password task final summary also uses modeless notification; unrelated task dialogs retain existing behavior
ui.privacy: Respect current SSID/BSSID masks, display verified password literally as plain text

validation.debian_limit: Available system Python lacks PySide6 and Paramiko; Windows Qt validation is not Debian desktop validation. The shared Qt-only implementation still requires Debian desktop acceptance.

history_read_only_check.explanation: Restarted progress counts remaining candidates anew. Confirmed outcomes are committed per candidate and skipped on later runs for the same BSSID+SSID. Unconfirmed/cancelled attempts are intentionally not persisted as wrong passwords. Clear button deletes all attempt fingerprints only, is disabled during tasks, and retains dictionaries and saved results.

reason: User may have an active verification task; changes apply after the user restarts the source application when idle.
